title: 第9章  下一剑要你的命
content_zh:
灵药峰，山脚下。
一位看起来约莫三十岁的中年男子站立。
这中年男子名为廉妄言，乃是炼药峰长老的记名弟子，虽然只是炼气六重境。
但却是一名一品炼药师。
凭借炼药师这个身份，在紫幕神山也有一些地位。
毕竟，诸多弟子所吞的凝气丹，大多数都出自这廉妄言之手。
至于其师傅，则负责炼制更高级的丹药。
“师兄，我们两个乃是前来负责种植灵药的杂役弟子！”
苏烬生走上前去，将手中的两个令牌递了过去，略显恭敬道。
廉妄言满脸傲气，眼中满是不屑神色，在他看来，自己乃是炼药师，高高在上的存在。
而苏烬生二人只是杂役弟子，整个紫幕神山最底层的存在罢了，根本不用正眼相看。
所以，一直都是藐视神色，恨不得鼻孔朝天，开口道。
“跟我来吧！”
音落，便要转身朝着灵药峰上走去，余光却突然瞟到了一个靓丽的存在。
不由得停下身子，仔细打量了林月舒一番，心中窃喜道。
想不到杂役弟子中竟然还有这等貌美的存在，这下种植灵药可有劲了！
随即，便继而迈步朝着山峰走去了。
苏烬生察觉到其目光之后，眉头不由得轻轻皱起，心生反感。
传闻这个记名弟子嚣张跋扈，且极其好色，如今一见，果然如此。
想来，灵药峰长老名声被败坏，与这记名弟子脱不了干系。

他才不管是不是炼药峰长老的弟子，只要敢惹他，照样杀之！
林月舒自然也察觉到了那厌恶的目光，只不过，并未出声言语。
毕竟这乃是人家的地盘，而且目光看人也不触犯宗门规矩，只能作罢。
随即二人便一同迈步，跟着廉妄言朝着山峰上走去。
这灵药峰较为庞大，灵气充足，除却一条主路，两条小路之外，其余各个地方都种植着灵药。
整座峰体宛若梯田一般，层层递进，每一层都种植着不同的灵药！
步入这山峰的瞬间，便能够察觉到其中的灵气比外围要浓郁几分。
淡淡的灵药香气也从中传出。
若是在这个地方修炼的话，速度绝对要比在外面快上几分。
这灵药峰地理位置特殊，灵气充沛，最为适合种植灵药。
即便如此，种十株灵药也才能存活三株而已，若是换做其他地方种植，可能十株都不能存活一株。
约莫过了两刻钟之后，三人走至半山腰处。
廉妄言停下脚步，盯着前方密密麻麻的灵药出声道。
“我们要种植的灵药乃是银龙草！”
“我来教你们采灵药，而后移植到身后的空地上，挖坑种下！”
说话间，灵气包裹一株银龙草，伸手握住下方根茎，轻轻拔起。
随即又到不远处的空地上，挖个坑轻轻埋下！
这银龙草通常存活一株之后，便会大面积繁衍，但是却很难长大。
只有将这银龙草分离开来，每一株之间有足够的间隙，才能尽快入药。
这银龙草算不上珍贵，但也不是百灵草能够比拟的。

通常很多一品丹药，乃至二品丹药都会用得上银龙草。
尤其是紫幕神山之中，需求更大，故而需要时常移植！
银龙草通体呈现银色，体型弯曲，两叶张开，一根直茎上涨，逐渐开出更多叶子。
通常情况下，只要开出六片叶子，便可摘下炼制丹药。
“你，去后面的空地处挖坑！”
廉妄言指了指苏烬生，开口吩咐出声，而后又看向林月舒，言语柔和道。
“这位姑娘，我们两个来移植灵药！”
“来，我手把手教你如何采摘这银龙草！”
说完后，便要去牵林月舒那嫩白玉手。
“你干什么！”
林月舒直接后退一步，怒喝出声，丝毫不给其面子。
苏烬生面色瞬间阴沉了下来，一步走到林月舒的身前，神色肃穆道。
“廉师兄，我劝你最好还是安分种植灵药，否则的话，就不要怪我不客气了！”
廉妄言不屑一笑，丝毫没有将苏烬生放在眼中，只是稍稍凝眸间，似乎想到了什么。
“我道是谁呢，原来是内门弟子第一人啊，难怪有这么大的口气啊！”
当初，苏烬生名满整个宗门，无人不知，无人不晓。
所以，廉妄言知晓，也并不奇怪。
“我劝你，还是不要多管闲事，好好挖你的坑去，不然的话！”
“我可不介意教训一下你这个内门弟子第一人！”
廉妄言脸上满是戏谑之色，直接威胁出声。

若是先前，他可能还不敢如此言语，但现在谁不知道苏烬生已经是一个废物了？
就算是杂役弟子都能踩上一脚，更何况他这个长老的弟子呢？
“真踏马给你脸了！”
苏烬生爆喝一声之后，拳头骤然紧握，灵气迸发，直接轰了出去。
这一拳，横冲直撞，没有什么花里胡哨的场面。
“竟然还敢动手，真是找……”
廉妄言话还没有说完，便感到胸口一痛，整个人直接倒飞出去，重重的落在地面上。
体内顿感翻云覆雨，一口鲜血涌上心头，喷吐而出！
剧烈的疼痛让他面色狰狞，双目瞪大，难以置信的盯着苏烬生。
他没有想到，作为炼气六重境的自己，竟然会被苏烬生打败！
下一刻，不由得放出神识查探而去，当发现苏烬生已经达到炼气五重境之时，整个人如遭雷击！
恢，恢复了！
苏烬生的丹田何时恢复了？
廉妄言的心中犹如掀起的千层海浪一般汹涌，久久无法平静。
即便是苏烬生恢复至炼气五重境，也不可能是他炼气六重境武者的对手啊！
一定是苏烬生偷袭所致，否则，他不可能败！
思索间，便已挣扎起身，
“竟然敢将我击伤！”
“我要你死！！”
低沉嘶吼间，一柄中品凡器钢刀便已出现在了手中。

下一刻，廉妄言便挥动着钢刀朝着苏烬生挥斩而去！
刀势凶猛，霸道至极，炼气六重境实力在这一刻彰显无疑。
“小心！”
林月舒见状，不由得连忙出声提醒。
苏烬生面色平静，丝毫没有将其放在眼里，意识挥动间取出中品凡器利剑。
身子微微一侧，便已躲过这刀势攻击。
紧接着手中剑刃挥斩，寒光划过，直入血肉！
“噗！”
顿时间，廉妄言胸口上多出一道深刻剑痕，鲜血疯狂涌出，染红衣衫。
身子也止不住的倒退数步，随之跌倒在地。
“啊！”
剧烈疼痛不由得让他嘶吼出声，连忙取出两枚疗伤丹药吞下。
这才顿感缓解几分。
“若是再敢动手，下一剑，可就要你的命了！”
苏烬生神色冰冷，言语凌厉，眼中绽放的杀意宛若恶魔一般席卷而去。
顷刻间，便已笼罩廉妄言全身，使得他忍不住打了个哆嗦，再也没有勇气出手。
但是这一口气，他还是吞不下去。
想他身为灵药峰长老的弟子，一直都是高高在上，何时吃过这样的亏。
“你们两个给我等着，我这就去叫我师傅前来！”
“我师傅一定会把你们打残打废的！”

说完便挣扎起身，几脚将大片银龙草踩死后，便朝着山上走去！
待会，就说他们两个非但不种植灵药，还将银龙草踩死大片。
以他师傅的暴脾气，肯定会将苏烬生二人打残打废！
恢复丹田又如何，突破至炼气五重境又怎样，还不是要被废？
“烬生哥哥，要不我们还是逃吧，不然等会张药师来了，我们恐怕吃不了兜着走啊！”
林月舒望着其离去的背影，眉头紧皱，眼中涌现出几分担忧神色，开口出声。
虽然苏烬生如今已经突破至炼气五重境界，但在张药师的面前，根本不够看。
若张药师真要动手，他们两个也就只有乖乖等死了！
“不用逃，张药师虽然脾气古怪，不讲理，但也绝对不会助纣为虐的！”
“放心好了，我们不会有事的！”
苏烬生并没有逃走的想法，反而开口安慰出声。
毕竟，一旦逃走的话，廉妄言想给他们安什么罪名就安什么罪名。
不如留在此地与之对峙，反正他们有理，并不惧怕什么。
况且，他先前与张药师见过几次面，还是有几分了解的。
这一次，廉妄言恐怕只会搬起石头砸自己的脚。
“我们还是先种植灵药吧，不用担心的！”
“嗯！”
林月舒见到苏烬生一副胸有成竹的模样，心中也安心不少。
随即便开始跟着其一同种植起了银龙草。
虽然被踩死了大片，但依旧还有很多可以移植。
content_en:
Spiritual Medicine Peak, at the foot of the mountain.
A middle-aged man who looked to be about thirty years old stood.
This middle-aged man's name is Lian Wangyan, and he is the registered disciple of the elder of Medicine Refining Peak, although he is only at the sixth level of Qi Refining.
But he is a first-grade alchemist.
With his status as an alchemist, he also has some status in the Purple Curtain Mountain.
After all, most of the Qi Condensing Pills swallowed by many disciples came from Lian Huanyan.
As for his master, he is responsible for refining higher-level elixirs.
"Senior brother, the two of us are the handyman disciples who are here to plant the elixir!"
Su Jinsheng stepped forward, handed over the two tokens in his hand, and said with some respect.
Lian Wangyan's face was full of arrogance, and his eyes were full of disdain. In his opinion, he was an alchemist, a superior being.
As for Su Jinsheng and the other two, they were just handyman disciples. They were at the bottom of the entire Purple Curtain Mountain. They didn't even need to look at each other.
Therefore, he always had a look of contempt, wishing he could turn his nostrils to the sky and speak.
"Come with me!"
After the sound fell, he was about to turn around and walk towards the Spiritual Medicine Peak, when he suddenly caught a glimpse of a beautiful person out of the corner of his eye.
He couldn't help but stop and look at Lin Yueshu carefully, feeling secretly happy in his heart.
I didn't expect that there would be such a beautiful person among the handyman disciples. Planting elixirs would be very exciting now!
Immediately, he continued to walk towards the mountain peak.
After Su Jinsheng noticed his gaze, he couldn't help but frown slightly, feeling disgusted.
It was rumored that this named disciple was arrogant, domineering, and extremely lustful. Now that I saw him, it turned out to be true.
Come to think of it, the reputation of the elder of Spiritual Medicine Peak was ruined, and it was closely related to this named disciple.
He doesn't care if he is a disciple of the elder of Medicine Refining Peak, if he dares to offend him, he will still kill him!
Lin Yueshu naturally noticed the disgusted gaze, but did not say a word.
After all, this is someone else's territory, and looking at people doesn't violate the sect's rules, so I can only give up.
Then the two of them stepped forward together, following Lian Wangyan towards the mountain peak.
This elixir peak is relatively large and has abundant spiritual energy. Except for one main road and two small roads, elixirs are planted in all other places.
The entire peak is like terraced fields, layer by layer, with different elixirs planted on each layer!
The moment you step into this mountain peak, you can notice that the aura inside is a bit richer than the surroundings.
A faint aroma of elixir also came from it.
If you practice in this place, your speed will definitely be faster than outside.
This elixir peak has a special geographical location and abundant spiritual energy, making it the most suitable place for growing elixirs.
Even so, if you plant ten elixir plants, only three will survive. If you plant them elsewhere, perhaps not even one of the ten will survive.
About two-quarters of an hour later, the three of them walked to the mountainside.
Lian Wangyan stopped, stared at the dense elixirs in front of him and spoke.
"The elixir we want to plant is Silver Dragon Grass!"
"I'll teach you how to collect the elixir, then transplant it to the open space behind you, dig a hole and plant it!"
As he spoke, spiritual energy wrapped around a silver dragon grass, and he stretched out his hand to hold the stem below and gently pulled it up.
Then he went to the open space not far away, dug a hole and buried it gently!
This silver dragon grass usually reproduces in a large area after one plant survives, but it is difficult to grow up.
Only by separating the Silver Dragon Grass with enough gaps between each plant can it be used as medicine as quickly as possible.
This silver dragon grass is not precious, but it is not comparable to lark grass.
Usually many first-grade elixirs and even second-grade elixirs use Silver Dragon Grass.
Especially in the Purple Curtain Mountain, the demand is greater, so transplantation is needed from time to time!
Silver dragon grass is silvery in color, with a curved shape, two leaves spread out, and a straight stem that rises and gradually blooms with more leaves.
Normally, as long as six leaves are found, they can be picked to refine the elixir.
"You, go dig a hole in the open space behind!"
Lian Wangyan pointed at Su Jinsheng, opened his mouth and gave instructions, and thenHe looked at Lin Yueshu again and spoke softly.
"This girl, let's transplant the elixir!"
"Come on, let me teach you step by step how to pick this silver dragon grass!"
After saying that, he went to hold Lin Yueshu's tender white hand.
"What are you doing!"
Lin Yueshu took a step back and shouted angrily, without giving him any face.
Su Jinsheng's expression instantly darkened, he walked up to Lin Yueshu and said solemnly.
"Senior Brother Lian, I advise you to plant elixirs peacefully, otherwise, don't blame me for being rude!"
Lian Wangyan smiled disdainfully and did not take Su Jinsheng into his eyes at all. He just stared for a moment and seemed to have thought of something.
"Who is it? It turns out he is the number one disciple in the inner sect. No wonder he has such a loud tone!"
At the beginning, Su Jinsheng was famous throughout the sect, and no one knew about it.
Therefore, it is not surprising that Lian falsely claims to know.
"I advise you not to meddle in other people's business and dig your own holes, otherwise!"
"I don't mind teaching you, the number one inner disciple, a lesson!"
Lian Wangyan's face was full of teasing, and he threatened directly.
If it were before, he might not have dared to say such words, but now who doesn't know that Su Jinsheng is already a waste?
Even a handyman disciple could step on him, let alone a disciple of an elder like him?
"I'm so proud of you!"
After Su Jinsheng shouted loudly, he clenched his fist suddenly, his spiritual energy burst out, and he blasted it out.
This punch was a rampage, with no flashy scenes.
"How dare you take action? I'm really looking for..."
Before Lian Wang could finish his words, he felt a pain in his chest. He flew backwards and landed heavily on the ground.
My body suddenly felt turbulent, and a mouthful of blood welled up in my heart and spat out!
The severe pain made his face look ferocious, his eyes widened, and he stared at Su Jinsheng in disbelief.
He did not expect that as a person in the sixth level of Qi Refining, he would be defeated by Su Jinsheng!
The next moment, he couldn't help but let out his spiritual consciousness to investigate. When he discovered that Su Jinsheng had reached the fifth level of Qi refining, his whole body felt as if he had been struck by lightning!
Recovery, recovery!
When did Su Jinsheng's Dantian recover?
Lian Wangyan's heart was turbulent like a thousand waves, and he could not calm down for a long time.
Even if Su Jinsheng recovers to the fifth level of Qi Refining, he cannot be his opponent as a warrior at the sixth level of Qi Refining!
It must have been caused by Su Jinsheng's sneak attack, otherwise, he would have been defeated!
While thinking about it, he struggled to get up.
"How dare you hurt me!"
"I want you to die!!"
With a low roar, a mid-grade mortal steel knife appeared in his hand.
The next moment, Lian Wangyan swung his steel knife towards Su Jinsheng!
The sword was fierce and overbearing, and his strength at the sixth level of Qi Refining was clearly demonstrated at this moment.
"Be careful!"
When Lin Yueshu saw this, she couldn't help but hurriedly reminded him.
Su Jinsheng's face was calm, and he didn't take it seriously at all. He took out a middle-grade mortal sword with a wave of consciousness.
Turning his body slightly to one side, he had already dodged the sword attack.
Then he slashed with the sword in his hand, and the cold light passed through and penetrated into the flesh!
"Poof!"
Immediately, there was a deep sword mark on Lian Wangyan's chest, and blood gushed out crazily, dyeing his clothes red.
Unable to stop, his body took a few steps backwards and then fell to the ground.
"Ah!"
The severe pain made him scream, and he quickly took out two healing pills and swallowed them.
Only then did I feel a little relieved.
"If you dare to take action again, the next strike will kill you!"
Su Jinsheng's expression was cold, his words were sharp, and the murderous intent in his eyes swept away like a demon.
In an instant, Lian Wangyan's body was enveloped, making him shiver and no longer have the courage to take action.
But he still couldn't swallow this breath.
He thought that as a disciple of the elder of Spiritual Medicine Peak, he had always been aloof, but when had he ever suffered such a disadvantage?
"You two, just wait for me. I'll call my master right away! "
“My master will definitely beat you to pieces! "
After saying that, he struggled to get up, trampled a large piece of Silver Dragon Grass to death with a few feet, and walked towards the mountain!
Later, they said that not only did the two of them not plant elixirs, but they also trampled large areas of silver dragon grass to death.
With his master's violent temper, he would definitely beat Su Jinsheng to death!
So what if you recover your Dantian, what if you break through to the fifth level of Qi refining, are you still going to be abolished?
"Brother Jin Sheng, why don't we run away, otherwise when Pharmacist Zhang comes later, we may not be able to eat and carry around! "
Lin Yueshu looked at his leaving back, frowning, with a look of worry in his eyes, and spoke.
Although Su Jinsheng has now broken through to the fifth level of Qi refining, it is not enough in front of Yaoshi Zhang.
If Pharmacist Zhang really wants to take action, the two of them will have no choice but to wait for death!
"There is no need to run away. Although Pharmacist Zhang has a weird temper and is unreasonable, he will never help others do evil! "
"Don't worry, we'll be fine! "
Su Jinsheng had no intention of running away, but instead spoke to comfort him.
After all, once they escape, Lian Wangyan can accuse them of whatever crime he wants.
It's better to stay here and confront them. Anyway, they are reasonable and have nothing to fear.
Besides, he had met Pharmacist Zhang several times before, and he still knew him somewhat.
This time, Lian may just shoot himself in the foot.
“Let’s plant the elixir first, don’t worry! "
"Um! "
Lin Yueshu felt relieved when she saw Su Jinsheng looking confident.
Then they began to plant Silver Dragon Grass along with it.
Although blockbusters have been trampled to death, there are still many that can be transplanted.
